subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Use Unit 1 words for jobs and places.
Use since/for and the Present continuous for plans correctly.
Find your strengths and set a goal for Unit 2.

tf.s: “This art gallery has been here for twenty years” is correct.
tf.why: Twenty years is a period, so we use for.

tf.s: “He has worked at the aquarium for 2016” is correct.
tf.why: 2016 is a point in time: since 2016.

tf.s: A camera operator controls a camera to film shows.
A theme park has rides and roller coasters.
tf.why: Yes, theme parks have exciting rides.

tf.s: “I'm meeting my friends at the bowling alley on Friday” is a future arrangement.
tf.why: On Friday shows a fixed plan.

tf.s: A puppeteer puts make-up on actors' faces.
tf.why: A make-up artist does make-up; a puppeteer works with puppets.

tf.s: Adverts often use imperatives like Visit and Watch.
tf.why: Imperatives speak directly to the reader.

tf.s: You can see paintings at an ice rink.
tf.why: You see paintings at an art gallery.

tf.s: A good learning goal is clear and says what you will do.
tf.why: For example: I will use word cards every day.

tf.s: “She are visiting her aunt tomorrow” is correct.
tf.why: She takes is: She is visiting her aunt tomorrow.

boxes.q: This art gallery has been here ___ twenty years.
Where can you see wild animals from a car?
boxes.why: A safari park has wild animals.

boxes.q: This person controls a camera to film shows.
He has worked at the aquarium ___ 2016.
Which is a feature of an advert?
Which place has stars and planets?
We ___ going to the circus tonight.
Which is a clear learning goal?
o: I will use word cards every day.
boxes.why: A goal says what you will do.

mcq.q: Write the job: This person controls a camera to film shows.
Which place has rides and roller coasters?

o: With a point in time, like 2016
With a period, like two years

mcq.q: Which four are features of a good advert?
o: logo, slogan, bullet points, special offer
mcq.why: These make an advert clear and persuasive.

mcq.q: Find and correct: He has worked at the aquarium for 2016.
o: He has worked at the aquarium since 2016.
He has worked at the aquarium for 2016 years.
He worked at the aquarium since 2016 ago.
He is working at the aquarium for 2016.

mcq.q: Complete: I'm ___ (meet) my friends at the bowling alley on Friday.
Which sentence describes a job correctly?
A student keeps making spelling mistakes with new words. Which goal is best?
o: I will learn the spelling of new words by using word cards every day.
I will stop learning new words.
mcq.why: A good goal fixes the problem with a clear action.

mcq.q: Which sentence is NOT about a future arrangement?
o: I've lived here for six years.
We're flying to Cairo in July.
mcq.why: The first one is the Present perfect, not the future.

o: We has been here since Monday.
She has been here since Monday.
I've known him for a year.
They've lived here for ten years.
mcq.why: We takes have: We have been here.
